protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No established human dose. The page reports only an old rhesus-monkey amount: 50 mcg per animal daily by IM injection for 10 days. The accessible human paper gives no dose, route, or course. 20 mg with 3 mL bacteriostatic water is a reconstitution reference only.

schedule.description: Reported per animal in rhesus monkeys; not a human dose.
